name: City slot-machine hook
technique: The lead line is on frame 0; the last word rolls like a slot machine through real Albanian places (drop-in per roll, pure function of time) and lands on the final one, then a rule draws and a quiet line blurs in.

options.label: Rolling words (comma separated, last one lands)
options.default: Sarandë, Vlorë, Durrës, Gjirokastër, Dhërmi, Tiranë
